title: Parameter - Textarea
description: The parameter is echoed in a TEXTAREA tag's CDATA. In this case, no parsing of the payload happens until </textarea> closes the element.
php:
Parameter - Textarea

The q parameter is echoed inside a <textarea> element.

Param: ?q=

⬇️ Reflected textarea:
objectives: Inject and execute JavaScript via HTML tags.
Understand why raw HTML inside a textarea does not execute until the textarea is closed.
hints: HTML tags inside <textarea> are treated as raw text.
